Note. Panel A gives the cross-validated R² of the cross-sectional frailty model (n = 5,410) with Tier 1 only, with all 177 predictors, and after excluding the 8 Tier 2 predictors coded as direct overlap and the 29 coded as direct or proximal overlap (leaving 132 Tier 2 predictors). SD is across the five folds; ΔR² is relative to Tier 1 only. Panel B lists the coded predictors. Direct overlap (a), the predictor duplicates or closely matches a frailty-index item; proximal overlap (b), the predictor is not an index item but could reflect the same self-reported health limitation or illness perception. The remaining Tier 2 predictors were coded as having no direct content overlap. ADL = activities of daily living.
